context:
Goal: the Post bar stays small enough that a card line still shows above it at every text size.
Problem (goal): without a cap the bar grows to 212 pt at the largest text size and no whole card line shows above it, and a cap needs your grant because it limits how big the bar's text gets.
Based on (ruling): you answered build B now on the Post bar question, with the note make the pin not so thick (2026-11-18 23:22 CST).
Based on (measured): the designer measured the bar at the default large text size: 128 pt as drawn, 61 pt in one row, 53 pt button only.
Departs from: main sets no cap on the bar's text — this caps it at the extra extra extra large size and shows the full text in the large-content viewer on press.
Waiting on: your answer; the builder waits on this for the largest text sizes.

designs.label: A: capped bar, 87 pt at the largest size

home: decision duo-card-in-hand and the open duo-hand-post-order

options.gain: The text always follows your setting.

reply: Built. Your answer a, the text capped at the extra extra extra large size, is on main (pull request 365, merged 2026-11-20 00:35 CST). Not measured: the large-content viewer on a device. Closed.
short: Post bar: cap its text at the extra large size

title: At the largest text sizes, may the Post bar's text stop growing at the extra extra extra large size, with the large-content viewer for the rest?
why: A bar that hides every card line is worse than text one step smaller, and the viewer keeps the full text reachable.
